definitions.gloss: wind exposure; how the wind hits
definitions.explanation: The degree to which a place is exposed to wind. Describes the physical force of wind striking something.
Figurative usage meaning the criticism or negative pressure directed at someone, especially from society, the public, or an organization.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{風当|かぜあ}たり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧。
examples.english: This spot is very exposed to the wind.

examples.japanese: ⟦{高台|たかだい}→高台：14683_takadai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で{風当|かぜあ}たり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}く→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧、⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{寒|さむ}い→寒い：00664_samui⟧。
examples.english: Being on a hill, it's very exposed to the wind and cold in winter.

examples.japanese: ⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{植|う}えて→植える：01210_ueru⟧{風当|かぜあ}たり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{和|やわ}らげた→和らげる：07897_yawarageru⟧。
examples.english: We planted trees to reduce the wind exposure.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧、⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{風当|かぜあ}たり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧。
examples.english: The company has been facing a lot of criticism lately.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政治家|せいじか}→政治家：03084_seijika⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{風当|かぜあ}たり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{厳|きび}しく→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧⟦なっている→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The pressure on politicians is growing harsher.

examples.japanese: ⟦{不祥事|ふしょうじ}→不祥事：14981_fushouji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧、⟦{世間|せけん}→世間：03299_seken⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{風当|かぜあ}たり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}く→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧、⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{辞任|じにん}→辞任：10144_jinin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{追|お}い{込|こ}まれた→追い込む：06371_oikomu⟧。
examples.english: After the scandal, public criticism intensified, and the company president was forced to resign.

notes:
Literally "wind hitting" — from ⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧ (wind) + ⟦{当|あ}たり→当たり：01919_atari⟧ (hitting/exposure). The figurative sense (criticism) is extremely common and may be more frequent than the literal one.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {風当|かぜあ}たり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧ (strongly exposed to wind; facing harsh criticism)
- {風当|かぜあ}たり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧ (criticism is severe)
- ⟦{世間|せけん}→世間：03299_seken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{風当|かぜあ}たり (public criticism)

USAGE:
Almost always paired with ⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧ or ⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧. The figurative usage is natural in news, business, and political contexts. Note that {風当|かぜあ}たり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{弱|よわ}い→弱い：00825_yowai⟧ (weak wind exposure) exists for the literal sense but is rarely used figuratively.
